name: Sumire Kakei
source:
Sumire Kakei is a kunoichi of Konohagakure's Scientific Ninja Weapons Team and former member of Team 15. Sumire has purple-colored eyes and hair. Even years after graduating from the Academy, Sumire's friends continue affectionately referring to her as Class Rep, due to having been such in their class at the Academy. At some point, her father placed the formula for the Gozu Tennō on her back. After letting go of her hatred, the Gozu Tennō was removed from her back. Soon after, it was replaced with a small red dot on her left palm, serving as an eye for Nue.

[In game description]
